loyal.strong: I'll hold the line until the last breath. Say the word.
loyal.moderate: I'll hold the line. Say the word.
loyal.weak: You can count on me. I'll do my part.

proud.strong: Watch closely — history remembers those who do things right.
proud.moderate: Watch closely—this will be done right.
proud.weak: I'll handle it properly. Don't worry.

reflective.strong: So many questions… and yet I find myself walking beside you. Perhaps that's the answer.
reflective.moderate: I have questions… but I will walk with you.
reflective.weak: I'm still working things out. But I'm here.

valiant.strong: For the cause — point me to the breach. I will not stop until it's done.
valiant.moderate: For the cause—point me to the breach.
valiant.weak: Tell me where I'm needed. I'll be there.

canny.strong: I've already mapped three paths forward. We'll take the smart one — fewer wounds, more wins.
canny.moderate: We'll take the smart path—fewer wounds, more wins.
canny.weak: Let's not rush this. There's probably a smarter way.

devout.strong: Asé flows through everything here. The ancestors walk with us — I will not falter.
devout.moderate: Asé guides us. I will not falter.
devout.weak: I trust the path. It will become clear.

stoic.strong: I've stood through fire, flood, and silence. Whatever this is — it won't break me. Let's move.
stoic.moderate: I've stood through worse. Let's move.

empathic.strong: I feel every one of them — every fear, every hope. I won't let a single one fall. We rise together.
empathic.moderate: I'll keep an eye on the others. We rise together.
empathic.weak: I'll watch out for people. That's what matters.

ambitious.strong: Give me a challenge worth remembering — something that will echo through time.
ambitious.moderate: Give me a challenge worth remembering.
ambitious.weak: Let's see what this turns into. I'm curious.
